leads.name: XeLab dual-phase xenon TPC (floating / spacer-assisted electrodes)
leads.note: Dual-phase xenon TPC at LPNHE Paris for electrode development towards XLZD, with single-electron production among its stated R&D topics; no public write-up of a single-electron measurement found yet.

leads.name: PANCAKE large-electrode test platform
leads.note: Large-electrode test platform in which a 1.33 m shallow dual-phase TPC has been operated; spurious emission of light and charge from large electrodes is a stated motivation, with no emission result published yet.

leads.name: LLNL dual-phase argon ionisation chamber (³⁷Ar sub-keV threshold)
leads.note: Dual-phase argon ionisation chamber with sub-keV threshold (Sangiorgio et al., 2013), in which single ionisation electrons were reportedly observed and used for absolute charge calibration.

leads.name: LoLX external-crosstalk measurement in liquid xenon
leads.note: LoLX views about 5 kg of liquid xenon with 96 VUV4 SiPMs; a direct measurement of SiPM external crosstalk in liquid xenon bears on correlated lone hits and fake few-fold S1s.

leads.name: XENON10 sub-GeV single-electron analysis
leads.institute: Stony Brook / LLNL / Tel Aviv (Essig, Manalaysay, Mardon, Sorensen, Volansky)
leads.note: Re-analysis of 15 kg-days of XENON10 single-electron-trigger data that set the first sub-GeV dark-matter-electron limits from 1-, 2- and 3-electron events; an early use of the few-electron population.

leads.name: F. Girard PhD thesis on SiPMs for xenon TPCs
leads.note: PhD thesis (2023) on SiPMs for xenon TPCs, relevant for SiPM dark counts and correlated noise as a source of accidental coincidences.

leads.name: LUX grid-conditioning emitter studies (theses)
leads.note: Localised electron and light emitters on the LUX gate grid seen during the 2014 conditioning campaign, described in two theses (A. Bailey 2016, W. Ji 2019); relevant to grid emission as a source of isolated S2s.

leads.name: Tsinghua gaseous-xenon detector for delayed electrons
leads.note: Possible separate gas-phase xenon detector used alongside the RELICS prototype TPC to study delayed electrons, presented in posters at TAUP 2025 and LIDINE 2025; no public write-up found yet.

leads.name: NUXE single-phase reactor CEvNS detector
leads.note: Planned ~100 kg single-phase liquid-xenon proportional scintillation counter for reactor CEvNS, designed to avoid single-electron backgrounds related to the liquid surface; no public write-up found yet.

leads.name: Scaling Up TPCs: space charge and pile-up effects
leads.note: LIDINE 2025 talk (R. Santorelli) on pile-up, S1–S2 misidentification and uncorrelated light from ion recombination in large argon and xenon TPCs; it is not stated whether measurements or only modelling are reported.

leads.name: XENON1T PMT qualification (R11410-21) light-emission and afterpulse tests
leads.note: Predecessor of the XENONnT PMT test campaign, relevant for micro light emission and afterpulses of the R11410-21 tubes installed in XENON1T.

leads.name: XENONnT / Nikhef photoluminescence in-situ analysis
leads.note: LIDINE 2025 talk (P. Kharbanda) on photoluminescence as a source of delayed photon and electron signals in XENONnT, with lone-hit pile-up driving the 2- and 3-fold lone-S1 rate; covered under the Nikhef bench and XENONnT entries.
